\begin{example} \end{example}[Hamilton--Jacobi complete integral] ↗ def:complete-integral 1. ch3:3.1-ex-3\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

For $u_t+H(Du)=0$, the family \[ u(x,t,a,b)=a\cdot x-tH(a)+b,qquad (a,b)\in \R ^{n+1}, \] is a complete integral. \end{example}
